title: Interpreting the Sinaitic Inscriptions in Context: A New Reading of Sinai 345
version: Hebrew Bible and Ancient Israel 2(2), pp. 136–148, author offprint

passages.note: Describes Egyptian and early alphabetic texts on Sinai 345, compares the Northwest Semitic dedication with the Egyptian Hathor reference and reassesses the harder-to-read alphabetical text from the earlier photographs.
